qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Self-reinforcing network density and irreplaceable physical terminal footprint (250+ owned/zoned cross-dock service centers) create massive scale economies shared. Unmatched service execution (99% on-time delivery, 0.1% cargo claims ratio vs industry average 1.5%) drives durable pricing power (revenue per cwt up 4-6% p.a. across all freight cycles). 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 32.7% (24.4% in 2025 trough) with best-in-class operating ratio (70-75% vs 85-95% for peers). Erosion threats from freight recessions or price wars are blunted by ODFL's premium service brand and low-cost non-union structure.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. The undisputed premier less-than-truckload (LTL) motor carrier in North America with an unreplicable nationwide terminal network, 99% on-time delivery, industry-leading operating ratio, net-cash balance sheet, and proven pricing power above inflation across freight cycles. Beneficiary of supply chain reshoring and insulated from AI disruption. qualitative.evidence: 10-year track record of industry-leading capital efficiency: 10-year GAAP and Tangible ROIC averaged >27% (peak 40.1% in 2022, trough 24.4% in 2025). Operating ratio consistently outperforms unionized and non-union peers by 800-1500 bps (75.2% in FY2025, improving to 71.5% in Q3 2026). Pristine balance sheet with essentially zero debt ($20M total debt vs $120M cash) and negligible interest expense. Outstanding capital allocation discipline demonstrated by walking away from overpriced Yellow terminal bidding in 2023, preserving balance sheet strength while continuing counter-cyclical network capex and share repurchases. Owner FCF conversion consistently near or above 100% of Net Income.
